newsitem.title: USA: PSA recommends early May 23, full May 26 close.
newsitem.headline: PSA recommends early May 23, full May 26 close.

text.p: PSA The Bond Market Trade Association said on Friday it was recommending an early close of 1400 EDT/1800 GMT on Friday, May 23 and a full close on Monday, May 26 in observance of Memorial Day.

The recommended hours apply to trading in U.S. government securities, mortgage securities, over-the-counter investment grade corporate bonds and municipal bonds as well as trading in assorted secondary money market instruments.
The early close on May 23 will not affect the closing time for settlements, the PSA said.
